scope: Initial working-tree changes plus validation fixes. Later concurrent dequant/scatter changes remain uncommitted and are not included in this evidence.

builds.target: Linux x86_64 host, transformer enabled, HTP/FP16 disabled
Android CausalLM and device test executables
builds.command: ndk-build with the repository Applications/CausalLM/jni and test/jni makefiles

builds.target: Hexagon v81 DSP skeleton from isolated committed source

host.isolated_runner_note: The isolated run completed through WEIGHT SWAP, then stopped because abs_max.h was omitted from the archive. After restoring that unchanged tracked header, the remaining abs-max and Q8 reuse checks were run with the same script commands and passed.
optional_checks_skipped: ARM NEON abs-max: aarch64 g++ or qemu-aarch64 unavailable

device.model: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra SM-S948N, SM8850

model_smoke.note: One run per mode verifies execution and output equivalence only. All outputs repeat cred, as already recorded by the earlier measurements; this is not a language-quality or perplexity check.

known_limitations.note: The baseline DSP image was compiled and loaded successfully for these calls. Its post-link undefined-symbol allowlist check returned an error for runtime math imports; the emitted image was used without changing its source.
Repeated cred output remains unresolved. Equal generated strings do not establish correct model quality.

Existing RegistryCapacity attempted a 6 GiB DSP allocation and caused MSM_UPLOAD. The device was manually rebooted. RegistryCapacity, MemoryCeilings and ArenaCeilingThenHeapHeadroom now require explicit gtest opt-in.
Windows, Tizen, Yocto and the full upstream build matrix were not run locally. Most workflows target main and may not run for a dependency snapshot base.

validation_fixes: Correct the Q attention planner test and comment to count the P buffer once across V groups; baseline reproduced the old host-test failure.
Disable the three intentional DSP memory exhaustion probes by default.
Apply clang-format 14 and satisfy touched-file Doxygen header/comment checks.
evidence_note: Historical benchmark reports elsewhere in this PR predate this final validation and are not claimed as measurements of the final commit.
